[IARC.8.2] **Memory discipline.** Per-object allocation
with matching free; no arena, reference counting only
where [IARC.1.13] names it, no longjmp-based error
recovery. OOM surfaces through
`ds_result_t`. See [IARC.1.13]. Specific
struct layouts and ownership-transfer rules per
API are [IDAT]'s.
